duas.title: Quranic Dua for Forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ﴿١٢٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ ﴿١٢٨﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas-Samee'ul-'Aleem. Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimaini laka wa min zurriyyatinaa ummatan muslimatal-laka wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub 'alainaa innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem.
duas.translation: (127) Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.(128) Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

benefits.title: Benefits of Quranic Dua for Forgiveness
benefits.description: This dua for forgiveness from Surah Baqarah asks Allah to accept our Amal, guide our family, and forgive our mistakes, bringing hope and mercy to every muslim who prays with a true heart.
points: Rabbana taqabbal minna helps Allah accept our Amal and namaz dua with mercy.
Dua for forgiveness in islam brings hope for sins to be wiped away by Allah.
Praying this quranic dua guides family and children to stay strong in Iman.
Dua of Ibrahim teaches muslims how to make tawbah and seek Allah’s Rahmah.
Istighfar prayer from surah baqarah brings peace and Barakah in daily life.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Forgiveness
when_to_recite.description: This dua for forgiveness is a strong way to ask Allah for mercy, Barakah, and to accept your Amal, especially when you want your heart clean and your Iman strong with true repentance in Islam.
points: After finishing salah, use the dua for forgiveness to ask Allah for acceptance.
When making istighfar prayer, recite this dua for forgiveness for your past sins.
At times of regret or guilt, turn to this dua for forgiveness for true tawbah.
Before starting a new Amal, pray with this dua for forgiveness for Barakah and guidance.
During Ramadan or special nights, remember this dua for forgiveness for more mercy.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Quranic Dua for Forgiveness
how_to_perform.description: This dua for forgiveness from Surah Baqarah is a strong quranic dua to ask Allah for mercy and acceptance. It is a masnoon dua that helps you seek forgiveness and Barakah for yourself and your family.
steps: After every salah, recite rabbana taqabbal minna with a soft heart and full hope in Allah.
When you feel sorry for sins, use this dua for forgiveness to make true tawbah and istighfar.
During Ramadan or special nights, pray this dua of ibrahim for more Barakah and mercy.
If you want Allah to accept your Amal, say this dua after prayer for forgiveness and peace.
While teaching kids, share this quranic dua to help them learn about repentance in islam.

duas.title: Dua of Child Gain
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mil-ladunka zurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka Samee'ud-du'aaa'.
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua of Child Gain
benefits.description: This dua for family from Surah Al Imran asks Allah for good children, bringing hope and Barakah to parents who want pious kids and happiness in their home.
points: Rabbi Habli Min Ladunka brings hope for pious and healthy children from Allah.
Dua to get pregnant helps muslim parents trust Allah’s plan for family growth.
Dua of Zakariya in surah al imran ayat 38 teaches patience and strong Iman.
Using this dua for family happiness brings peace and love in the home.
Islamic dua for parents asks Allah to make the child a joy and Barakah for all.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Family
when_to_recite.description: This dua for family is a heartfelt way to ask Allah for good children, Barakah, and happiness, using the words of dua of Zakariya for those wishing for a pious family and strong Iman.
points: After every salah, make the dua for family to ask Allah for pious children.
When longing for a child, use this dua to get pregnant with hope and full trust.
During times of sadness about family, pray this dua for family happiness and Barakah.
At gatherings with parents, recite the dua of parents for good offspring and unity.
Before starting surah maryam for pregnancy, begin with this dua for family blessings.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua of Child Gain
how_to_perform.description: This dua of Zakariya from Surah Al Imran ayat 38 is a heartfelt prayer for those wishing for good children and family happiness. It is a well-known Islamic dua for family, often recited by parents and couples hoping for Barakah in their home and to get pregnant.
steps: Start by making fresh wudu and sit in a clean place before you ask Allah with this dua for family.
After every salah, raise your hands and recite Rabbi Habli Min Ladunka with full hope in your heart.
When you visit the masjid or during tahajjud, repeat this dua to get pregnant and ask for Allah’s mercy.
If you read surah maryam for pregnancy, add this quranic dua to your zikr allah for more blessings.
Parents can say this masnoon dua together for family happiness and pray for good children always.

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness of Sins
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ ﴿٤٠﴾ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ ﴿٤١﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-'alnee muqeemas-Salaati wa min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aaa'. Rabbanagh-fir lee wa liwaalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul-hisaab.
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.(40) Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.(41)

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Forgiveness of Sins
benefits.description: This prayer for forgiveness of sins from Surah Ibrahim asks Allah to forgive us, our parents, and all believers, while making us strong in Salah and Iman every day.
points: Rabbi jalni muqimas salati helps muslims stay strong in Salah and Amal.
Dua for parents in surah ibrahim ayat 41 brings Allah’s mercy for family.
Prayer for forgiveness of sins wipes away mistakes and brings peace in heart.
Rabbighfirli waliwalidayya asks Allah to forgive parents and all believers.
Using this dua for forgiveness brings Barakah and hope on the Day of Hisab.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Prayer For Forgiveness Of Sins
when_to_recite.description: This prayer for forgiveness of sins is a gentle way to ask Allah for mercy, Barakah, and to forgive you, your parents, and all believers, using the words from surah Ibrahim for strong Iman and Amal.
points: After every salah, pray this prayer for forgiveness of sins for you and your parents.
When remembering deceased parents, use this dua for parents for Allah’s mercy.
At times of weakness in salah, recite rabbi jalni dua to ask for Barakah in your prayer.
Before making dua for family, include this prayer for forgiveness of sins for all.
On the day of Jummah, remember this dua for forgiveness for all believers and your family.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Prayer for Forgiveness of Sins
how_to_perform.description: This prayer for forgiveness of sins from Surah Ibrahim ayat 40-41 is a strong muslim prayer that asks Allah to forgive you, your parents, and all believers. It is a quranic dua for parents and family, and brings Barakah when recited with Iman.

At night before going to bed, recite this rabbana dua for forgiveness of all believers and family.
If you visit the graveyard, read this dua for deceased parents and ask Allah for their mercy.
During your zikr allah, add this dua for forgiveness to your daily masnoon duas for more Barakah.

duas.title: Dua for parents
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.

Using this quranic dua for parents brings Barakah and peace in family life.
Prayer for parents in islam keeps the bond of kindness and Amal strong always.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Parents
when_to_recite.description: This dua for parents is a loving way to ask Allah for mercy and Barakah for your parents, using the words from surah Isra to show thanks for their care and to keep your Iman strong.

When visiting your parents, recite this islamic prayer for parents for Barakah and health.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Parents
how_to_perform.description: This dua for parents from Sura Isra ayat 24 is a heartfelt islamic prayer for parents, asking Allah to show mercy just as they cared for you when you were small. It is a quranic dua for parents that brings Barakah and happiness to your family.
steps: After every salah, quietly recite rabbir hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera for your parents’ mercy.
When you see your parents or remember them, make this dua for parents with love in your heart.
If your parents are sick, use this dua for parents health and ask Allah to give them shifa.
For parents who passed away, read this dua for deceased parents and pray for their forgiveness.
During your daily zikr allah, add this masnoon dua to your prayers for more Barakah and peace.

duas.title: Dua for Mercy and Good Outcome
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa mil-ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Mercy and Good Outcome
benefits.description: This dua for success from Surah Kahf asks Allah for His mercy and right guidance, helping muslims find the best path and Barakah in every step of their life and Amal.
points: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan brings Allah’s mercy in hard times.
Dua for success in surah kahf helps muslims get right guidance in every Amal.
Using this dua from quran makes affairs easy and brings good outcome always.
Surah kahf ayat 10 teaches muslims to trust Allah for help and Barakah.
Islamic dua for guidance keeps the heart strong and away from wrong ways.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Success
when_to_recite.description: This dua for success from Surah Kahf asks Allah for mercy and right guidance, bringing Barakah and help in your Amal, especially when you want a good end and strong Iman in your daily life.

When facing a big test or exam, use rabbana atina from surah kahf for a good outcome.
Before making a big choice, ask Allah with this dua for guidance and right path.

When you want forgiveness and mercy, include this dua from quran in your daily zikr.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Success
how_to_perform.description: This dua for success from Surah Kahf ayat 10 is a strong quranic dua asking Allah for mercy and right guidance in all matters. It is a well-known rabbana dua that brings Barakah and helps you find the best outcome in life.
steps: After finishing your salah, ask Allah with this dua for success and hope for His mercy.
When you start a new work or face a hard time, recite rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan for help.
In the early morning, read this dua for guidance to get Barakah and right path for your day.
If you feel lost or need forgiveness, add this dua from quran to your zikr allah for peace.
Before making big choices, use this masnoon dua to ask Allah for a good outcome and happiness.

duas.title: Dua for the Family
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for the Family
benefits.description: This dua for the family from Surah Furqan asks Allah to bless our home with loving spouses and children, making us a good example for others and bringing peace to every muslim heart.

Dua for righteous spouse helps muslims get loving and caring partners in life.
Using this dua for family happiness brings Barakah and unity in the home.
Surah furqan dua makes a muslim family a good example for the muttaqin.
Prayer for family in islam keeps loved ones safe and close to Allah’s mercy.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For the Family
when_to_recite.description: This dua for the family from Surah Furqan asks Allah for Barakah, happiness, and righteous loved ones, making your home a place of Iman, comfort, and good Amal for all.
points: After every salah, recite the dua for the family to ask Allah for a happy home.
When feeling worried about your kids, use rabbana hablana min azwajina for their safety.
Before going to bed, make dua for family happiness and peace in your house.
At times of family gathering, remember this dua for protection of family and unity.
When starting a new marriage, include this dua for righteous spouse in your daily zikr.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for the Family
how_to_perform.description: This dua for the family from Surah Furqan ayat 74 is a beautiful quranic dua asking Allah to bless your spouse and children with happiness and make your home a place of Barakah. It is a strong muslim prayer for family happiness and unity.
steps: After every salah, recite rabbana hablana min azwajina with hope for family comfort and peace.
When you see your spouse or children, quietly make this dua for righteous spouse and good kids.
Before going to bed, read this dua for family happiness and ask Allah to protect your loved ones.
If you feel worried about your family, use this prayer for family to seek Allah’s help and Barakah.
During your zikr allah, add this masnoon dua for the family to your daily prayers for more unity.

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude and Righteous Deeds
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-lateee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen.
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Gratitude and Righteous Deeds
benefits.description: This prayer helps a muslim remember Allah’s gifts and ask for good Amal, making hearts soft and thankful while seeking blessings for self and parents in every part of life.
points: Allah gives more Barakah to the one who makes this dua for gratitude in Islam.
This dua for parents brings health and long life for mother and father.
Thank you Allah prayer helps a muslim stay humble and close to Allah’s mercy.
Surah Naml dua for blessings keeps family safe and Amal strong every day.
Grateful prayer from Quran helps muslims join the ranks of Allah’s righteous servants.

when_to_recite.title: When to Recite Dua For Gratitude
when_to_recite.description: This dua for gratitude from Surah Naml helps you thank Allah for His blessings, ask for Barakah in your Amal, and pray for your parents’ health and Iman every day.

When making dua for parents, include this prayer of gratitude for their health and long life.

When feeling happy with your family, make this dua for blessings and thank Allah together.

how_to_perform.title: How to perform Dua for Gratitude and Righteous Deeds
how_to_perform.description: This dua for gratitude from Surah Naml is a beautiful way to thank Allah for His blessings, ask for good deeds, and pray for your parents. It brings Barakah and helps you remember Allah’s favors every day.

When you see your parents, quietly make this dua for parents and ask for their health.

Before going to bed, whisper this grateful prayer to Allah for all the gifts and Barakah in your life.

duas.title: Dua for Child in Quran
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Family and Righteous Child

how_to_perform.description: This short dua for family from Surah As-Saffat is a heartfelt prayer asking Allah to bless you with a righteous child and bring goodness to your home. It is a simple islamic dua that brings hope and Barakah to every Muslim family.

While making dua for your family, include this quranic dua for a son or daughter with pure niyyah.

duas.title: Dua for Parents, Good Deeds, and Righteous Family
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-lateee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee zurriyyatee innee tubtu ilaika wa innee minal-muslimeen.
duas.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Parents and Righteous Family
benefits.description: This prayer from Surah Al-Ahqaf helps muslims thank Allah for His gifts, ask for good Amal, and seek blessings for parents and children, making family ties strong and hearts full of Iman.

Surah Al Ahqaf dua for forgiveness brings peace and tawbah for the whole family.

Quranic dua for parents and children brings Allah’s mercy and keeps family united.

duas.title: Dua for Family Protection from Shirk
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij-'al haazal-balada aaminan wajnubnee wa baniyya an na'budal-asnaam.

Islamic dua for family protection brings Allah’s Rahmah and keeps Amal strong.

When leaving home with your family, use this dua for protection from evil and harm.

When you feel worried about your children, quietly say this dua for protection from evil for them.

duas.title: Dua of Infertile Person
duas.arabic: وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِن وَرَائِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا ﴿٥﴾
duas.transliteration: Wa innee khiftul-mawaaliya min waraaa'ee wa kaanatim-ra'atee 'aaqiran fahab lee mil-ladunka waliyyaa.
duas.translation: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

duas.title: Dua for Jannah and Forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ ﴿٧﴾ رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ ﴿٨﴾ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ ﴿٩﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shai'ir-rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'azaabal-Jaheem. Rabbanaa wa adkhilhum jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'adtahum wa man salaha min aabaaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa zurriyyaatihim; innaka Antal-'Azeezul-Hakeem. Wa qihimus-sayyi-aat; wa man taqis-sayyi-aati Yawma'izin faqad rahimtah; wa zaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem.
duas.translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.(7) Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.(8) And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment." (9)

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Jannah and Forgiveness

duas.title: Dua for Parents Forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee wa liwaalidayya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat; wa laa tazidiz-zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa.
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

benefits.title: Benefits of Dua for Parents Forgiveness
benefits.description: This dua for parents from Surah Nooh is a heartfelt prayer for maghfirat, asking Allah to forgive parents, yourself, and all believers, bringing Barakah and mercy to your home and family with every recitation.

duas.title: Dua for Increasing Ibadah and Provision
duas.introduction: Ibrahim (AS) prayed the following Dua for his children and family:
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa liyuqeemus-Salaata faj'al af'idatam-minan-naasi tahweee ilaihim warzuqhum minath-thamaraati la'allahum yashkuroon.
duas.translation: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

duas.title: Dua for Rizq Halal
duas.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيْ خَطَايَايَ وَذُنُوبِيْ كُلَّهَا، اَللَّهُمَّ انْعِشْنِيْ وَأَحْيِنِيْ وَارْزُقْنِيْ وَاهْدِنِيْ لِصَالِحِ الْأَعْمَالِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ، إِنَّهٗ لَا يَهْدِيْ لِصَالِحِهَا وَلَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allahummaghfir lee khataayaaya wa dhunubi kullahaa, Allahumman ‘ishni wa a’hyini warzuqni wahdini lisaalihil a’maali wal akhlaaqi innahu laa yahdi li’saalihihaa wa laa yathrifu sayyiyaha illaa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me all my sins. O Allah, grant me high rank. Give me a good life and halal food. Guide me also into the good behaviors and to avoid displaying some profane ones. Surely no one can guide me to good deeds and good morals except you. No one can save me from evil deeds and inferior character except you.
